tools_helpful.evidence: Copied .cs/.xaml/.resw/appdata from the UWP source and produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md + MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md; 12/13 scenarios migrated and function.
Flagged ResourceContext/ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView() via the 'getforcurrentview' anchor, routing the agent to a PATTERNS.md section.

tools_problematic.problem: The single generic '\bGetForCurrentView\s*\(' adaptable pattern routes ALL GetForCurrentView() calls to the windowing-only 'getforcurrentview' section, which declares 'None of the GetForCurrentView() patterns work in WinUI 3 desktop'. That absolute statement is false for the resource flavors and caused the agent to defer scenario9.
tools_problematic.evidence: MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md lists scenario9.xaml.cs with anchor 'getforcurrentview'; constants.cs omits Scenario9 entirely.

tool_limitations.limitation: Verifies Package.appxmanifest image references resolve under Assets/, but does NOT verify in-app XAML 'Image Source=' / ms-appx file references resolve to a copied physical (or qualifier-variant) file.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Optionally extend Section 7-style checks to warn when a XAML Image Source path has no matching file (or scale-/contrast-/language-variant) under the project.

failed_apis.why_tried: scenario9 (Override Languages) sets the current view's default context language at runtime and listens for QualifierValues.MapChanged.
failed_apis.root_cause: Skill's 'getforcurrentview' section says none of the GetForCurrentView() patterns work, so the agent deferred the file instead of using the trivial view-independent replacement.
failed_apis.fix: Replace with 'new ResourceContext()' (or 'ResourceManager.Current.DefaultContext'), set context.Languages / context.QualifierValues[...] to override, and resolve via ResourceManager MainResourceMap.GetValue(id, context). MapChanged/Reset work on the constructed context. The agent already used exactly this pattern in the passing scenarios 7/8/10.

doc_errors.wrong: 'None of the GetForCurrentView() patterns work in WinUI 3 desktop.' (absolute)
doc_errors.correct: Only the view/windowing singletons lack a desktop equivalent. ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView() -> new ResourceLoader(); ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView()/GetForViewIndependentUse() -> new ResourceContext(). These are migrations, not deferrals.

special_apis.special_handling: Construct a view-independent ResourceContext, then set context.Languages or context.QualifierValues['language'|'scale'|'contrast'|'homeregion'] and resolve named resources via ResourceManager MainResourceMap.GetValue(id, context).

special_apis.api: MRT image/file resource variants (Image Source, ms-appx:///)
special_apis.special_handling: Physical qualifier-variant files (.scale-###, .contrast-###, language folders en-US/, ja/) must be carried into the project as Content; MRT resolves the logical name at runtime. In UWP SDK samples these live in a shared/ sibling folder, not the cs/ project folder.

errors_encountered.error: scenario2 images render as blank white boxes
errors_encountered.root_cause: The Images/ qualifier-variant tree (shared/images/, incl. en-US/ and ja/ folders and .scale-*/.contrast-* files) was never copied into the migrated project; only shared/strings and shared/xaml were carried over.
errors_encountered.fix: Copy the full in-app image/file resource variant tree into the WinUI 3 project (Build Action = Content) so MRT can resolve Image Source='Images/projector.png'.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Deferred on the false premise that ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView() has no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent.
errors_encountered.fix: Migrate with new ResourceContext() + qualifier override (see failed_apis).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Labeled 'defer' and removed Scenario9 from constants.cs, even though a near-identical view-independent ResourceContext pattern was successfully applied in scenarios 7/8/10.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Overbroad 'getforcurrentview' guidance the analyzer routed it to.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Carve the resource-loader/resource-context flavors out of the getforcurrentview 'no equivalent' claim and give them explicit replacements in the MRT section.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Descriptive text migrated but both Image controls blank.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No skill guidance to carry in-app qualifier-variant image/file resources; sample stored them in shared/images/.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add an 'in-app image & file resource variants' subsection instructing the agent to copy the qualifier-variant tree (from shared/ if present) as Content and verify each XAML Image Source resolves.

missing_tooling.need: A check that in-app XAML Image Source / ms-appx file references resolve to a copied file or qualifier-variant.
